SW4-companion-B (2026-05-26) — Parent app fee-demand listing excludes archived demands. Required by FeeFirestoreRepository.kt getFeeDemands / getPendingDemands / observeFeeDemands which add .whereNotEqualTo('status', 'archived') alongside the 3 equality filters (schoolId, session, studentId). Without this composite index Firestore returns FAILED_PRECONDITION on first query.

SW4-companion-C (2026-05-27) — Teacher app class fee-demand observer excludes archived demands. Required by FeeFirestoreRepository.kt observeClassFeeDemands which adds .whereNotEqualTo('status', 'archived') alongside the 4 equality filters (schoolId, session, className, section). Without this composite index Firestore returns FAILED_PRECONDITION on first query, the .catch fallback emits empty, and the class summary card's per-month rollup goes blank.
